subject: Cross-region demo scheduling with VentureCorp
messages:
From: Rick Johnson <rick.johnson@venturecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Quick demo request + timezone question

Hi Marissa,

We'd love to schedule a demo of Redwood for our search/summarization pipeline next week. Our team is US-based (Eastern timezone) and weekdays in the mornings ET work best.

Do you have availability on Nov 3 or Nov 4 between 9:00–11:00 AM ET? We do want to include some folks in engineering and product (I'll loop them in once we pick a slot). Also attaching a short requirements doc for context.

One other ask — the last few scheduling threads got messy because of daylight savings differences between our US team and EMEA. If you could list times with explicit timezones (ET / UTC / CET) that would help.

Thanks,
Rick Johnson
Director of Product
VentureCorp

[Attachment: VentureCorp-Requirements.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rick Johnson <rick.johnson@venturecorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 21:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick demo request + timezone question

Thanks Rick — happy to coordinate.

Quick note on DST: EU switched back on Oct 25 (now CET/UTC+1). The US shift is on Nov 1 this year, so for dates early next week there is a one-hour offset vs. some previous weeks. I'll list slots with explicit zones to avoid confusion.

Proposed slots (all in local times + UTC):
- Nov 3: 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET / 17:00 UTC / 18:00 CET
- Nov 3: 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET / 19:00 UTC / 20:00 CET
- Nov 4: 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET / 17:00 UTC / 18:00 CET
- Nov 4: 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET / 18:00 UTC / 19:00 CET

Jonas (copied) will be joining from our EMEA team and can confirm which of those he can make. If you prefer a narrower window (e.g., 9–11 AM ET), tell us which day and we'll lock it in.

Proposed agenda: 30–40 min demo + 15 min Q&A. I’ll attach a short agenda and send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

[Attachment: Redwood-Demo-Agenda.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]

Subject: Re: Quick demo request + timezone question

Thanks Marissa — that helps.

We'd prefer to avoid very late / very early slots for our execs. Could we aim for Nov 4 between 9:00–11:00 AM ET? Ideally 10:00 AM ET if that fits EMEA availability. If Nov 4 at 10:00 AM ET works, please go ahead and send an invite.

Looping in our product lead (cc omitted here) after you confirm. Attached a quick screenshot of our team availability.

Cheers,
Rick

Perfect — Nov 4 at 10:00 AM ET works for our EMEA folks. To be explicit:

Confirmed slot:
- Nov 4, 2026 10:00 AM ET / 15:00 UTC / 16:00 CET

Jonas and Evelyn will join from EMEA. I’ve created a calendar invite and attached the .ics below, and included the agenda. Please let me know if you want us to extend the Q&A.

Invite & Agenda: https://drive.google.com/redwood/demo-agenda-DC-2026-074

Thanks everyone — see you on Nov 4.

Best,
Marissa
